Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, minor water damage occurred in our office due to a burst pipe, resulting in repair costs of $3,500. The claim was filed, assessed, and successfully closed as of April 10, 2023. On June 22, 2023, we experienced a theft of surveying equipment valued at $11,500. The claim is still pending investigation and resolution.
